text:
ellie: Heads-up — prepping the boardroom webinar + launch posts next week. Need a compact SEO checklist we can action today: keywords, schema snippets, internal links, and redirect fallbacks for legacy CTAs. Who can own each?
noah: I can take keywords + canonical decisions. Quick ask — do we have seed KW list from product PR?
ben: I have the draft launch posts. Will map 3 pillar pages -> webinar landing. Will add anchor text variations.
maya: I’ll own inbound routing (UTMs + lead destination rules). We should add fallback to form endpoint if hubspot is slow. :thinking_face:
ellie: @noah use the product PR doc (link: https://drive.redwood/launch/pr-notes) for seed terms. Aim for 6 primary + 10 longtails each page.
noah: Cool. My plan: 1) run keyword clustering, 2) update page titles/meta, 3) produce canonical mapping table.
ben: FYI I’ll include structured snippet examples. Sample JSON-LD we can reuse for the webinar page: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Boardroom Webinar: Inference at Scale","startDate":"2025-04-10T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/boardroom"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
maya: For redirects: legacy CTA /signup-old -> /webinar/boardroom?utm_source=legacy with 302 during launch week, then 301 after 30 days. Also map /docs/old-inference -> /docs/inference-basics (avoid chain >1).
noah: I’ll run a quick site scan. seo-bot, can you post redirect-chain report?
seo-bot: site-scan complete — found 6 redirect chains, 12 pages with missing schema, 4 pages with duplicate canonical tags. See /scans/1759876543-report.csv
ellie: Thanks. Prioritize: remove duplicate canonicals (high), add Event schema to webinar page (high), set planned redirects (mid).
ben: I’ll update internal linking matrix tonight: map anchor slots from blog posts -> webinar and 2 product pages. Short anchors and long anchors.
maya: For lead routing: if HubSpot returns 5xx, fallback route to /leads/sqs-queue with tokenized payload. Also capture utm_term into hidden field.
noah: One more: add the following robots-meta on the staging webinar mirror to prevent indexing: `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">`
ellie: Great. Can everyone drop a ✅ when done on their piece? I'll compile final launch SEO checklist and send to boardroom comms.
noah: ✅
ben: ✅ (will ping when matrix uploaded)
maya: ✅
seo-bot: redirect changes deployed to staging at 1759876590
ellie: Awesome — moving this to action. Thanks team :rocket:
